scripts.prebuild: node -e "const p=require('./src/data/papers.json'); const fs=require('fs'); const latest=p.toSorted((a,b)=>b.date.localeCompare(a.date))[0]?.date||''; fs.writeFileSync('src/data/stats.json', JSON.stringify({totalPapers:p.length,generatedAt:new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],latestPaperDate:latest},null,2)+'\n')"
